name: claude-loadout
description: Personal Claude Code loadout: a pre-commit secret gate, a configurable corporate GitLab fork->MR workflow, and a cross-model second-opinion reviewer. Add this marketplace on any machine, install the plugins you want.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Pre-commit secret gate: a PreToolUse hook scans staged changes and blocks commits carrying secrets, plus a semantic review subagent. Zero config.

plugins.name: corporate-gitlab
plugins.description: Configurable corporate GitLab workflow: fork->MR push guard, commit identity + sign-off + Jira-key gate, and a skill teaching the flow. Set CORP_GIT_* env vars, then run /corporate-gitlab:setup once per machine.

plugins.name: litellm-council
plugins.description: Cross-model council via your self-hosted LiteLLM proxy (curl-based, no MCP). Run /litellm-council:setup once (or set LITELLM_BASE_URL / LITELLM_API_KEY / LITELLM_COUNCIL_MODELS), then :second-opinion (review the current diff), :ask (any question), or :debate (two rounds where models see each other's answers).
